tooltip.createbackoff.resistor.deny: You are not the owner of this Resistor
createbackoff.ponder.resistor_intro.head: Resisting Entities
createbackoff.ponder.resistor_intro.text: The Resistor uses rotational force to repel entities
When set up correctly, the Resistor can block entities
createbackoff.ponder.resistor_speed.head: Resistor's Size
createbackoff.ponder.resistor_speed.text: The bounding box's size is tied to the Resistor's speed
Increases the size of it's influence
createbackoff.ponder.resistor_filter.tex: By default, the Resistor will block everything except the Owner
Use Legal Paper on a mob to add it's name to the filter
Then use the Restraining Order on the Resistor to configure it
